from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied
import boto3
from django.conf import settings
from .models import DiagnosticScan

class MedicalScanDownloadUrlView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request, scan_id):
        scan = get_object_or_404(DiagnosticScan, id=scan_id)
        if scan.patient.user != request.user and not scan.assigned_physicians.filter(user=request.user).exists():
            raise PermissionDenied("Access denied to medical diagnostic scan")

        s3 = boto3.client("s3")
        url = s3.generate_presigned_url(
            "get_object",
            Params={"Bucket": settings.AWS_HEALTH_BUCKET_NAME, "Key": scan.dicom_file_key},
            ExpiresIn=300
        )
        return Response({"download_url": url, "scan_id": scan.id})
